source: The abstraction is hierarchical because the hardware is hierarchical. Blocks provide a unit that can be placed on an ZXNAME0000XZ. Warps provide the native thread grouping used by the ZXNAME0001XZ execution model. Registers and shared memory provide on-chip state. Caches and device memory feed data. Different pipelines execute different instruction classes.[1]
zh: 抽象是分层的，因为硬件是分层的。块提供了可以放置在 ZXNAME0000XZ 上的单元。 Warps 提供 ZXNAME0001XZ 执行模型使用的本机线程分组。寄存器和共享内存提供片上状态。缓存和设备内存提供数据。不同的流水线执行不同的指令类。[1]
